scope: Development comparison on fixed input pixels. Mask and feature agreement is not ground-truth cutting-path accuracy or physical assembly validation.
changes: Short searches admit colour-retaining coarse seeds whose openings still need closure.
A checked broad-refinement checkpoint hands off to bounded local detail once its original unweighted image error and colour retention pass.
Short searches reserve local-detail and finalization time, with a larger local refinement rate. Final acceptance thresholds are unchanged.

timingDefinitions.timeLimit: Requested solver search allowance, not an end-to-end latency limit.
timingDefinitions.detectionSeconds: Crop detection wall time. Decoding and the source thumbnail are outside this timer.
timingDefinitions.runSeconds: Each runs[].seconds starts after crop detection and source-thumbnail creation. Includes preparation, solving, validation, export, independent replay and per-case artifact writes; excludes decoding and detection.
timingDefinitions.solveAndValidationSeconds: design() wall time, including final validation and generated export data. Excludes crop detection, preparation, independent replay and writing artifacts.
timingDefinitions.independentReplaySeconds: Separate exported-SVG renderer wall time; not part of application solving.
timingDefinitions.browser: Actual click-to-ready latency is measured separately by paint-browser-test.mjs.

regressionHistory.beforeCheckpointHandoff: 21 passed, 1 failed: short bird sometimes did not apply feature detail. Preserved in targeted.log.
regressionHistory.afterCheckpointHandoffFocused: 1 passed: the short bird test independently renders exported templates at 400 and 800 pixels. Preserved in short-handoff-test.log.

browserRetry: The initial browser run could not load rebuilt entry assets from the old preview server. Restarted the same owned server, verified the served fitter hash and both entry modules, then reran all five cases into browser-final without changing application code.
visualReview: Inspected the bird photograph crop and both independently rendered paired outputs, then final browser screenshots for bird and star. The bird retains its eye but has uneven borders and thin seams. Numerical acceptance is not an exact original-design reconstruction.
browserQualification: Default browser searches use the ordinary 180-second allowance. These replay checks do not demonstrate a ten-second browser solve.
